title: ACMG/AMP variant classification specifications from the ClinGen Epilepsy Sodium Channel Variant Curation Expert Panel.
abstract: ClinGen Variant Curation Expert Panel adapted ACMG/AMP sequence-variant classification rules for SCN1A, SCN2A, SCN3A, SCN8A and SCN1B, piloting modified criteria on 37 variants across missense, nonsense, frameshift and intronic types. Specifications emphasize epilepsy-syndrome phenotyping, optimized population thresholds (BS1/BA1), paralog-based criteria (PS1/PM5) and functional-data interpretation (PS3).
